title: Atlanta
sideASummary: Player deck back. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Blue Atlanta Player card, 33°47'60"N 84°19'46"W. One covered SEARCH box. Not a port. This is Atlanta's only Player card. Code P1-11b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: You may move 1 card in the Infection discard pile to the Game End area. Resolved once, when the box is scratched.

states.summary: The plague started when a group blew up the CDC, destroying the CCdA virus and releasing a plague. You may move 1 card in the Infection discard pile to the Game End area.

rules: Blue Player card for Atlanta. One land search box, labeled SEARCH. No anchor.
Scratching the box lets you move 1 card from the Infection discard pile to the Game End area.
The result is immediate. It is not a companion.
This is Atlanta's only Player card. It goes to the reserve until Atlanta joins the grid.
notes: Card id 908. Scratched face card id 1006. Printed code P1-11b.
The scratch spells the virus CCdA. The recon report spells it COdA.
